title: Staging Recovery System Tool surface closure

phases.objective: Expose the already-governed Staging Recovery canary planning and access-repair authorities through bounded Admin System Tools, close Recovery Action bridge v2 schema/handler parity in composed runtime, add read-only Local Connector convergence evidence, prevent category-invalid tunnel restart loops, and keep Production free of Staging-only tool advertisement or mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Discover or call the fixed Admin System Tool surface through the composed runtime.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Staging advertises bounded Recovery planning/approval tools backed by existing server-managed authorities; Production does not advertise those tools; Recovery execution bridge accepts the v2 server-managed confirmation contract and never exposes caller-controlled execution tickets, SQL, commands, credentials, or Production authority.
steps: Synchronize the Recovery Action bridge descriptor to its existing v2 implementation contract before System Layer requests are served.
Advertise the Staging Recovery canary-plan, access-repair prepare/approve, and readiness tools only when the runtime is Staging.
Create canary plans through the durable Staging Recovery store without executing the canary or mutating target databases/providers.

Create access-repair plans/challenges and issue server-signed single-use tickets through the existing Staging access-repair authority without accepting caller SQL, commands, target selection, credentials, signatures, or tickets.
Project Staging capability reporting as a bounded control-plane surface while preserving the kernel's discovery-only subview.
Keep Production Recovery behavior available through the same v2 bridge while Staging-only descriptors remain absent from Production discovery.
Inspect the Windows listener owner, runtime roots, services, tasks, identity presence, DNS state, and Staging/Local tunnel isolation without reading credential values or mutating the host.
Classify DNS, identity, route, and Cloudflare edge failures independently; restart the Local Connector tunnel only for the bounded Cloudflare 1033 edge class.
assertions: Staging Recovery System Tool descriptors are Admin-only, fixed-schema, private-recovery tools and are not advertised outside Staging.
The certification canary plan operation may write durable Recovery control-plane state but performs no target-database, provider, DNS, deployment, or Production mutation.
Access-repair System Tools delegate to createStagingAccessRepairTicketAuthority and do not reimplement grant, approval, signing, or execution-ticket authority.
Access-repair plans are bound to the server-observed repository-owned Recovery Manifest hash and fail closed when the deployment attestation does not prove that manifest binding.
Recovery Action bridge v2 accepts approval_id, expected_sha, typed_confirmation, and idempotency while keeping execution ticket identifiers/hashes/signatures server-controlled.
Production mutation is not enabled by this change and Production never receives Staging target authority.
Live Staging certification is required after merge because runtime routing and Recovery System Tool composition change.

The convergence inspector reports duplicate owners, runtime-root drift, missing identity, and cross-runtime binding while performing no restart, install, credential-value read, provider call, DNS write, or database mutation.
DNS resolution failures and HTTP 401/403 identity failures never trigger a cloudflared restart; only the classified Cloudflare 1033 edge failure may do so.
